subject: Recording Crystal
text: Using a Recording Crystal while alone in Kirito's room triggers a flashback scene of Sachi.

evidence.quote: 後、一人の時に自室で記録結晶を使ってみよう。
evidence.translation: Also, try using a recording crystal in your room when you are alone.

subject: Katana
text: Katana can be equipped, but its skill proficiency will not increase unless Curved Sword skill is raised and the prerequisite skill is acquired.

evidence.quote: 刀は装備こそできるが、曲刀スキルを上げて前提スキル習得済みでないとスキルが一切伸びない。
evidence.translation: Although katana can be equipped, the skill will not grow at all unless you raise curved sword skill and have acquired the prerequisite skill.

subject: Katana
text: Most Katana skills possess the diamond attribute, making them easy to cancel.

evidence.quote: なお、刀はスキルの大半が◇属性だったりといろいろ玄人向け。
evidence.translation: Furthermore, katana is for experts as most of its skills have the diamond attribute.

subject: Equipment
text: Because shop prices are extremely high, weapons other than your main weapon should be acquired from treasure chests and Last Attack bonuses.

evidence.quote: 物価が鬼のように高いので、メインで使う武器以外は買うより宝箱やLAボーナスで入手していきたい。
evidence.translation: Because prices are insanely high, you should acquire weapons other than your main weapon from treasure chests and LA bonuses rather than buying them.

subject: Weapon Proficiency
text: Weapon skill increases easily up to around 200, slows down rapidly past 500, and becomes a grind beyond 700.

evidence.quote: 武器スキルは200くらいまでは簡単に上がるが、500を超えたあたりから急激に伸びづらくなり、700超えると苦行。
evidence.translation: Weapon skill rises easily up to around 200, but from around 500 it becomes sharply harder to raise, and beyond 700 it is torture.

subject: Skill Points
text: Learning every sword skill and battle skill requires 1079 spt total, needing 1000 mastery in all weapons plus 790 internal mastery points out of 3000.

evidence.quote: 全てのソードスキル・バトルスキルを習得するには合計で1079spt必要。これはすべての武器の熟練度を1000にした上で...3000まで上がるシステム内部の熟練度をさらに790も稼がなければいけない。
evidence.translation: To learn all sword skills and battle skills, a total of 1079 spt is required. This requires raising proficiency of all weapons to 1000... and additionally earning 790 internal system proficiency that goes up to 3000.

subject: Sword Skill
text: Each weapon has 9 to 10 sword skills, but there are only 8 skill slots available.

evidence.quote: ソードスキル9～10個に対してスキル枠は8なのであらかじめ切り捨てるスキルを決めておく
evidence.translation: There are 9 to 10 sword skills compared to only 8 skill slots, so decide in advance which skills to discard

subject: Battle Skill
text: HP and SP recovery battle skills often affect the entire party and are essential for preventing casualties during floor boss battles.

evidence.quote: HP・SP回復系はPT全体が対象のものも多く非常に便利。フロアボス戦で戦死者を出したくない場合は特に重要。
evidence.translation: HP and SP recovery skills often target the entire party and are very useful. They are especially critical if you do not want casualties in floor boss fights.

subject: Floor Boss
text: Stun and Skill Seal battle skills are effective against floor bosses and can incapacitate them for long periods when multiple are equipped.

evidence.quote: スタン・スキル封印系は階層ボスにも効果があり、複数セットしておくと長時間、相手を無力化することができる。
evidence.translation: Stun and skill seal skills are effective even against floor bosses, and equipping multiple can incapacitate the opponent for a long time.

subject: SP Charge
text: SP Charge is a Tactics battle skill derived from the Spear skill tree.

evidence.quote: SPが足りないなら槍と細剣からそれぞれ派生する、「戦術」の「SPチャージ」と「電光石火」の「ライトニングアタック」が有用。
evidence.translation: If you lack SP, Tactics' SP Charge and Lightning's Lightning Attack, derived respectively from spear and rapier, are useful.

subject: Lightning Attack
text: Lightning Attack is a Lightning battle skill derived from the Rapier skill tree.

evidence.quote: SPが足りないなら槍と細剣からそれぞれ派生する、「戦術」の「SPチャージ」と「電光石火」の「ライトニングアタック」が有用。
evidence.translation: If you lack SP, Tactics' SP Charge and Lightning's Lightning Attack, derived respectively from spear and rapier, are useful.

subject: Partner AI
text: Developing partner AI requires Crimson Weapon and hate management skills.

evidence.quote: パートナーのAI育成にはクリムゾンウェポンやヘイト管理のスキルが必須。
evidence.translation: For partner AI training, Crimson Weapon and hate management skills are essential.

subject: Sword Skill
text: Diamond attribute sword skills are easily interrupted by regular enemy attacks and waste SP, so star attribute skills should be prioritized.

evidence.quote: ソードスキルは◇と☆の二種があり、前者は通常攻撃で簡単にキャンセルされSPも無駄になる。☆印を優先するといい。
evidence.translation: Sword skills have two types, diamond and star; the former is easily cancelled by normal attacks and wastes SP. You should prioritize star-marked ones.

subject: Secret Skill
text: Secret skills carry the diamond attribute but can be triggered regardless of distance from the enemy.

evidence.quote: 奥義技は◇印だが、距離に関係なく発動可能。
evidence.translation: Secret arts are diamond attribute, but can be activated regardless of distance.

subject: Partner Selection
text: Partners are fixed per floor from Floor 76 to Floor 80, and become selectable from Floor 81 onward.

evidence.quote: 76～80まで層ごとに固定、81層から選択可能。
evidence.translation: Fixed per floor from 76 to 80, selectable starting from floor 81.

subject: Partner Level
text: Partners other than Asuna join with an initial level in the late 80s, requiring level training through Crime Servant to survive.

evidence.quote: アスナ以外の初期レベルは80台後半。原作通りの階層＋10程度まで上がっているが、そのままでは力不足。...クライムサーバントでちゃんとレベルを上げてやること。
evidence.translation: Initial levels other than Asuna are in the late 80s. They are raised to about floor + 10 as in the original story, but as is they lack strength... Level them up properly with Crime Servant.

subject: Skill Assist Bug
text: A bug resetting partner Skill Assist to level 1 can usually be resolved by returning to town or restarting the game.

evidence.quote: 街に戻ったりゲームの再起動で治ることが多い。
evidence.translation: It is often cured by returning to town or restarting the game.

subject: Partner Equipment Bug
text: Partners will appear with their weapons unequipped if they share a map with Kirito while not in a party, which fixes upon entering another map.

evidence.quote: キリトさんと同じマップにいてパーティを組んでいないと武器を外した状態になる。バグか仕様かは不明。違うMAPに行くと治る。
evidence.translation: If in the same map as Kirito and not forming a party, they enter an unequipped weapon state. Unclear whether bug or feature. Cured by going to a different map.

subject: Treant Dominator
text: The Treant Dominator on Floor 77 and the scorpion swarm outside the town gate on Floor 81 pose deadly hazards for Assault Team members.

evidence.quote: 77層のトレントドミネーター、81層街門前のサソリの群れが特に危険。
evidence.translation: Floor 77's Treant Dominator and Floor 81's swarm of scorpions in front of the town gate are especially dangerous.

subject: Assault Team
text: Assault Team members have stat tiers prioritized by Avatar Contest winners, standard leaders, and general guild members, with males having higher HP and two-member guilds having higher stats than three-member guilds.

evidence.quote: 攻略組はアバターコンテスト出身、通常リーダー、その他ギルメンの3タイプがおり、この順に確率補正などが付与されており能力が高い。...一般的RPG同様、女性より男性のほうがHPが高く、最初から二人組のギルドは3人組より能力が高め。
evidence.translation: The Assault Team has 3 types: Avatar Contest winners, normal leaders, and other guild members, with higher abilities and stat bonuses in this order... Like typical RPGs, males have higher HP than females, and guilds that are two-person from the start have higher stats than three-person guilds.

subject: Assault Team
text: Recruiting a dedicated tank equipped with a shield and heavy armor requires bringing in an Assault Team member.

evidence.quote: また、盾と重鎧装備の純粋タンクが欲しい場合は攻略組から引っ張ってこないとならない。
evidence.translation: Also, if you want a pure tank equipped with shield and heavy armor, you must pull one from the Assault Team.

subject: Assault Team
text: Early floor boss raids feature the Knights of the Blood and Holy Dragon Alliance guilds, followed by the Two-Handed Axe Research Group and Those Who Inherit the Stars.

evidence.quote: 開始直後は原作の2大ギルド《血盟騎士団》と《聖竜連合》が出てくるが、一周目ではその後は当分《両手斧研究会》と《星を継ぐもの》でほぼ固定される。
evidence.translation: Right after starting, the 2 major guilds from the original story, Knights of the Blood and Holy Dragon Alliance, appear, but afterwards in the first playthrough it is mostly fixed with Two-Handed Axe Research Group and Those Who Inherit the Stars for a while.

subject: Assault Team Requests
text: Assault Team member locations can be tracked via FRIEND in the menu, and quest targets display an exclamation mark bubble above their head when in the appropriate field.

evidence.quote: 攻略組PTはゲーム内の時間に合わせて街と特定フィールドを往復している。メニューのFRIENDから相手の現在地が確認できる。...依頼が解決できるエリアにいると頭上に（！）の吹き出しが出るので一緒に敵を倒すと進行。
evidence.translation: Assault Team parties commute between town and specific fields according to in-game time. You can check the other person's current location from FRIEND in the menu... When they are in an area where the request can be resolved, an exclamation mark (!) balloon appears above their head, and defeating enemies together progresses it.

subject: Floor Boss
text: Each floor boss can only be fought once per playthrough, but resetting at the results screen before activating returns the player to just before the strategy meeting.

evidence.quote: 各階層のボスは１回きり。どうしても全LAを取得したいなら、アクティベートの前にリザルト画面で再起動。攻略会議の直前まで戻れる。
evidence.translation: Each floor boss is only once. If you really want to obtain all LAs, restart on the result screen before activating. You can return to right before the strategy meeting.

subject: Floor Boss
text: Defeating a floor boss with Kirito dealing the Last Attack awards fixed bonus equipment such as the Duel series, whereas partner finishing blows do not award the item.

evidence.quote: 取るとデュエルシリーズなどの強い装備を一つ入手できる。キリトがLAを取る必要があり、パートナーがトドメを刺してもアイテムは入手できない。各階層でドロップアイテムは固定で、クリアランクによる変化はない。
evidence.translation: Obtaining it yields a piece of strong equipment such as the Duel series. Kirito must get the LA; even if a partner lands the finishing blow, the item cannot be obtained. Drop items are fixed for each floor and do not change based on clear rank.

subject: Floor Boss Evaluation
text: Floor boss evaluation rank depends on damage dealt, damage received, attack interruptions, and zero casualties, while clear time is not factored into the score.

evidence.quote: 判定条件は与えたダメージ、受けた被ダメージ、攻撃妨害、戦死者の4つ。...攻撃妨害はボスのソードスキルなどをバッシュなどでキャンセルすれば加点。そして戦死者はなしが前提で、一人でも死ぬとBランク以上にならない。クリアタイムは計算されないので注意。
evidence.translation: Evaluation conditions are 4: damage dealt, damage received, attack interruption, and casualties... Attack interruption awards points if you cancel boss sword skills with bash etc. And zero casualties is a prerequisite; if even one person dies, it will not be B rank or higher. Note that clear time is not calculated.

subject: Goblin Leader
text: The Goblin Leader is found inside a cave accessed by following the left wall from the entrance and dropping down in Wild Pioneer Land on Floor 77.

evidence.quote: 77層、荒らぶる開拓地。入口から左壁沿いに進み、降りたら洞窟内。
evidence.translation: Floor 77, Wild Pioneer Land. Proceed along the left wall from the entrance, drop down and it is inside the cave.

subject: Camilla's Request
text: The Sweet Sap required for Camilla's request is dropped by Treant monsters rather than goblins.

evidence.quote: ゴブリンを狩っているが、対象アイテムを落とすのはトレント（樹人）のモンスター。
evidence.translation: They are hunting goblins, but the target item is dropped by Treant (tree-man) monsters.

subject: Camilla's Request
text: Unlike standard NPC assistance requests, Camilla's request requires collecting the items and turning them in rather than fighting together.

evidence.quote: 他の手伝いと違ってカミラたちと一緒に戦う必要はなく、アイテムを集める→渡す、という流れ。
evidence.translation: Unlike other help requests, you do not need to fight together with Camilla and the others; the flow is collect items -> hand them over.

subject: Camilla's Request
text: Pre-collecting Sweet Sap in the preceding forest allows immediate completion of Camilla's request when it activates.

evidence.quote: ひとつ手前の森をぐるぐる回って事前にアイテム集めておくと、依頼が進行→即達成となり楽に終わる。
evidence.translation: If you circle around the preceding forest to collect the item in advance, the request will progress -> immediately achieve, making it easy to finish.

subject: Teleport Crystal
text: Teleport Crystals cannot be bought in shops and only 3 to 6 can be gathered per floor.

evidence.quote: 転移結晶。非売品。各層で3〜6個程度は拾えるが、使いすぎに注意。
evidence.translation: Teleport crystal. Not for sale. About 3 to 6 can be picked up on each floor, but beware of using too many.

subject: Teleport Crystal
text: Partnering with Asuna grants unlimited Teleport Crystal usage as she supplies her own crystals.

evidence.quote: アスナさんはどこからともなく結晶を調達してくる為、コンビ組んでいれば彼女の結晶を使い放題。
evidence.translation: Because Asuna procures crystals from out of nowhere, if you form a duo with her you can use her crystals unlimitedly.

subject: Floor Boss Last Attack Equipment
text: Floor boss Last Attack bonus equipment and fallen Assault Team members are permanently missable.

evidence.quote: 階層ボスのLA(ラストアタック)ボーナス装備、攻略組の死亡
evidence.translation: Floor boss LA (Last Attack) bonus equipment, death of Assault Team members

subject: Rage Ring
text: Hidden passive skills on equipment can be viewed on the Active Skill screen by pressing SELECT, such as the Rage Ring which grants permanent Counter.

evidence.quote: 装備品の隠し効果。SELECTのアクティブスキル画面で確認できる。...例えばバトルスキルのカウンター効果は時間制限アリだが、レイジリング装備中は永続カウンターがつく
evidence.translation: Hidden effects of equipment. Can be confirmed on the active skill screen with SELECT... For example, the counter effect of battle skills has a time limit, but while equipping the Rage Ring, permanent counter is applied.

subject: Dark Repulser
text: The genuine Dark Repulser is obtained exclusively as the Last Attack reward from defeating the 100th Floor boss.

evidence.quote: 本物が見あたらないのは、誰も到達していない100層ボスのLAだからだ！
evidence.translation: The real one cannot be found because it is the LA of the 100th floor boss that no one has reached!

subject: Lambent Light
text: Lambent Light is rewarded as the Last Attack bonus from defeating the 91st Floor boss.

evidence.quote: 他にも色々知っているぜ？ランベントライトが91層LAだとか、エリュシデータは98層LAだとかな。
evidence.translation: I also know various other things: Lambent Light is the 91st floor LA, and Elucidator is the 98th floor LA.

subject: Elucidator
text: Elucidator is rewarded as the Last Attack bonus from defeating the 98th Floor boss.

evidence.quote: 他にも色々知っているぜ？ランベントライトが91層LAだとか、エリュシデータは98層LAだとかな。
evidence.translation: I also know various other things: Lambent Light is the 91st floor LA, and Elucidator is the 98th floor LA.

subject: Dual Wield
text: Dual Wield is available from the start, using two equipped One-Handed Swords.

evidence.quote: は最初から使える。...を2本装備すること。
evidence.translation: Dual Wield can be used from the start. Equip two one-handed swords.

subject: Battle Skill
text: Unlocking battle skills requires raising various weapons, and enemies with extreme attribute resistances make even development advisable.

evidence.quote: の解放にも各種の武器を育てるのが必須の他、極端な属性耐性を持つ敵（突：スケルトン系、打：スライム系）もいるのでまんべんなく育てたほうが良い。
evidence.translation: In addition to raising various weapons being mandatory to unlock battle skills, there are also enemies with extreme attribute resistances (Thrust: Skeletons, Strike: Slimes), so it is better to raise them evenly.

subject: Dagger
text: Daggers have a default Poison debuff and good skill fuel efficiency and attack interval, but low attack power.

evidence.quote: | 毒 | 良好なスキル燃費と攻撃間隔。武器にはST異常、スキルには能力ダウンのデバフが豊富 | 攻撃力が低め
evidence.translation: Dagger | Poison | Good skill fuel efficiency and attack interval. Weapons have status ailments, skills have plenty of stat-down debuffs | Low attack power

subject: One-Handed Sword
text: One-Handed Swords have a high weapon stat increase and are easy to handle, with no notable flaws but no sharp strengths.

evidence.quote: 武器の能力上昇値が高め、扱いやすい | 欠点らしい欠点がないが、尖った長所もない
evidence.translation: High weapon stat increase, easy to handle | No notable flaws, but lacks sharp advantages

subject: Two-Handed Sword
text: Two-Handed Swords have high-power wide-area skills, a star-attribute secret art, and many CT-rate weapons, but terrible skill fuel efficiency.

evidence.quote: 高威力かつ広範囲のスキル、☆属性の奥義。CT率補正武器が多い | 劣悪なスキル燃費
evidence.translation: High power and wide-area skills, star-attribute secret art. Many weapons with critical rate bonuses | Terrible skill fuel efficiency

subject: Rapier
text: Rapiers activate sword skills quickly and have many weapons with hit-rate bonuses.

evidence.quote: ソードスキルの発動が早い、命中補正武器が多い
evidence.translation: Fast sword skill activation, many weapons with hit rate bonuses

subject: Katana
text: Katanas have a default Bleed debuff and balance power with skill fuel efficiency, but their star-attribute skill is only level 1 and they unlock very late.

evidence.quote: | 出血 | 威力とスキル燃費が両立、出血デバフがデフォ | ☆属性スキルがレベル1のみ。解禁も非常に遅い
evidence.translation: Bleed | Both power and skill fuel efficiency, default bleed debuff | Star-attribute skill only at level 1. Very late unlock

subject: Curved Sword
text: Curved Swords have a default Absorb debuff but unlock late relative to their performance, after learning One-Handed Sword SA4.

evidence.quote: | 吸収 |  | 性能の割に解禁が遅め（片手剣SA4習得）
evidence.translation: Absorb | | Late unlock considering performance (requires learning One-Handed Sword SA4)

subject: Dual Wield
text: Dual Wield has high-performance skills and stacking one-handed sword stat bonuses, but lacks a decisive finisher against multiple enemies.

evidence.quote: 高性能なスキル群、片手剣の能力補正が重複 | 複数相手の決め手にかける
evidence.translation: High-performance skill set, stat bonuses of one-handed swords duplicate | Lacks decisive finishing power against multiple opponents

subject: One-Handed Club
text: One-Handed Clubs have a default Paralysis debuff and are the only weapon with Strike-attribute normal attacks, but have long attack intervals.

evidence.quote: | 麻痺 | 唯一の通常攻撃打属性 | 攻撃間隔長め
evidence.translation: Paralysis | The only normal attack with strike attribute | Long attack interval

subject: Two-Handed Axe
text: Two-Handed Axes have a default Stun debuff and high-power sword skills plus a star-attribute secret art, but long attack intervals.

evidence.quote: スタン | 高威力のソードスキル、☆属性の奥義 | 攻撃間隔長め
evidence.translation: Stun | High power sword skills, star-attribute secret art | Long attack interval

subject: Spear
text: Spears have a default Seal debuff, sword skills with abundant abnormal debuffs that branch into useful battle skills, but are unreliable as a damage source.

evidence.quote: 封印 | ソードスキルは異常系デバフが豊富。便利なバトルスキルへ派生。 | ダメージ源としては頼りない
evidence.translation: Seal | Sword skills have abundant abnormal status debuffs. Derives into convenient battle skills. | Unreliable as a damage source

subject: Shine Circular
text: Get Dual Wield's Shine Circular first; using it at higher levels mostly handles regular enemy fights.

evidence.quote: のシャイン・サーキュラーを取っておこう。レベルを上げてこれを撃っていれば雑魚戦はだいたいなんとかなる。
evidence.translation: For now, get Dual Wield's Shine Circular. If you raise your level and use this, mob fights will mostly be handled.

subject: Round Accel
text: Dagger's Round Accel and Two-Handed Axe's Whirlwind are very strong sword skills.

evidence.quote: [短剣](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/64.html "短剣 \(3581d\)")のラウンドアクセル、[両手斧](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/70.html "両手斧 \(3578d\)")のワールウインド、トランプルアクト（パーフェクションスタイルと併用）が非常に優秀。
evidence.translation: Dagger's Round Accel, Two-Handed Axe's Whirlwind, and Trample Act (used together with Perfection Style) are excellent.

subject: Two-Handed Axe and Two-Handed Sword secret arts
text: The secret arts of Two-Handed Axe and Two-Handed Sword have the star attribute and are hard to cancel, though they have drawbacks like weak power or terrible fuel efficiency.

evidence.quote: の奥義技は☆属性。奥義にしては威力控えめ、あるいは燃費が異常なまでに劣悪などの欠点はあるがキャンセルされにくいのは大きい。
evidence.translation: The secret arts of two-handed axe and two-handed sword have star attribute. They have drawbacks like modest power for a secret art or terrible fuel efficiency, but being hard to cancel is huge.

subject: Hashish
text: Hashish has the highest stats numerically, but actual performance depends on equipment and skill issues.

evidence.quote: 数値の上での最強はハシーシュ。装備やスキルの問題があるため、実際の性能はまた別であるが。
evidence.translation: The strongest in terms of numbers is Hashish. Due to equipment and skill issues, actual performance is another matter though.

subject: Treant Dominator
text: The large Treant in the same area is the SNM Treant Dominator, a very strong enemy, so lure its minions out with knives.

evidence.quote: 同エリア内の大きいトレントは例のSNMトレントドミネーター。相当の強敵なので取り巻きをナイフで釣るといい。
evidence.translation: The large treant in the same area is that SNM Treant Dominator. It is a considerably tough enemy, so lure out its minions with knives.

subject: START OF LAYER
text: Resetting before the map-transition auto-save returns you slightly earlier, and START OF LAYER on the title screen is another way to resume.

evidence.quote: マップ切り替え時のオートセーブが入る前にリセットすることで少し前に戻れる。
evidence.translation: Resetting before the auto-save on map transition returns you a little earlier.

evidence.quote: タイトル画面の「START OF LAYER」で再開する、という手もある。
evidence.translation: There is also the option of resuming with 'START OF LAYER' on the title screen.
